disciplines.Vocational (short-term): Noncredit: 53412(j)(4): for an occupation the district offers or has offered apprenticeship in, the noncredit apprenticeship qualifications

apprenticeship_53413.words: Apprenticeship instructors of credit and noncredit courses in a program the Division of Apprenticeship Standards approves. A course and program attribute, not a discipline. Credit: an associate degree and four years in the trade; or six years, a journeyman's certificate and twelve units; or six years and ten years as a DAS apprenticeship instructor; or a district's urgency policy. Noncredit: the credit qualifications, or a high school diploma, six years in the occupation (two at journey level) and sixty hours of instruction methods.

disciplines.Counseling: Mental Health: License from the California Board of Psychology or Board of Behavioral Sciences (or their minimum qualifications)

credential_required.words: The discipline's own minimum qualification requires a license or certificate.

dsps_53414.words: Disabled Students Programs and Services: counselors, adapted physical education, speech and language, credit specialized instruction (a master's in the area and fifteen units), noncredit specialized instruction (53414(e), noncredit vocational courses under (e)(4)), and Learning Disabilities Specialists.

learning_assistance_53415.words: Learning assistance instructors: any master's discipline in which assistance is given at the college, or a master's in education or adult learning; none applies where no apportionment is claimed.

license_53410_1.words: Professional license as an alternative: a bachelor's in the discipline plus a valid California license substitutes for the 53410 qualifications.

licensed_occupations_53417.words: Any credit or noncredit course: a current California license or certificate wherever program or course approval requires one, or local hiring judges it essential. Applies course by course, never to a discipline as a whole.

noncredit_53412.words: Noncredit instructors: the credit discipline's qualifications, or the subsection named for the course's kind. A noncredit course with no subsection of its own (COCI's Workforce Preparation, for one) takes its credit discipline's qualifications.

work_experience_53416.words: Work experience instructors and coordinators: the qualifications of any discipline in which work experience may be given at the college.

types.any: Master's not generally expected; any bachelor's or associate degree plus experience (CCR 53410(d))
types.specific: Master's not generally expected; a bachelor's or associate degree in the discipline plus experience (CCR 53410(c))
